connector.name: Routekit
connector.registryDescription: Route optimization API for Brazil. Routes, distance matrices, and VRP solver.
connector.summary: Hosted at routekit.nexterait.com.br over streamable HTTP, also runs locally from the npm package routekit-mcp. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches all 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the luisbretasjr account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.
